verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a document converter shipped as a CLI and library, with an optional HTTP server mode (pandoc-server). An auth layer for that server is conceivable, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows any credential issuance, API keys, or scoped or least-privilege access controls for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
